title: Versioned Profile compiled into the digest-bound activation plan
statement: The X-Verse platform must compile a versioned io.xverse.xcom Profile into a digest-bound, versioned activation plan whose digest rule is normative.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007 Profile v0.1 and activation-plan v1 contract.
verification_intent: Realized for the T020 test slice by T020-SR-003 and T020-SR-005.
acceptance_criteria: The plan version const, digest algorithm, and digest pattern equal the normative schema.
A version or digest drift is rejected fail-closed.
